messages:
Nora (CSE): HelioTech onboarding blocked today during a scale smoke: lots of 429s when their edge fleet started up after a config push. Noted at 14:12 UTC.

heliotech-eng: Pasted example: `2026-08-03T14:12:07Z POST /v1/embeddings 429 rate_limit tenant=heliotech instance=edge-7` then `2026-08-03T14:12:08Z ephemeral refresh ok id=tkn_hl2x` then retries spike. ~150 simultaneous init attempts observed.

Abe (SDK): Which SDK and pattern? Are they fetching ephemeral per-worker or using a shared proxy?

heliotech-eng: Using go-sdk v0.6.0 in an autoscaled edge service. Each worker fetches ephemeral token on start and immediately calls embed(). No init jitter or token cache.

Kofi (Platform): This looks like a large preflight fanout combined with a shorter ephemeral overlap window. Any recent infra changes? @deploy-bot visible in last 48h?

deploy-bot: Deploy note: 2026-08-03T03:05:10Z - token-service change: ephemeral_grace reduced from 11s -> 5s for canary (owner: infra/token-service).

ops-oncall: That reduction will expose init races on high-parallel fleets. Ops can apply a tenant-level grace bump and a short ingress smoothing rule while SDK patch is rolled. I can apply a 40m override.

Nora (CSE): HelioTech flagged this as high-impact for their POC; they asked for a hotfix and docs. Renewal touch: they were scheduled for a review next week — if onboarding stalls they'll escalate to procurement.

Abe (SDK): Immediate SDK suggestions: 1) add process-local token cache with TTL buffer; 2) default init jitter (100-350ms) for edge/go runtimes; 3) add a circuit-breaker on init path to limit retries to 2 with exponential backoff. I can cut a 0.6.1 patch today.

heliotech-eng: We can patch but need a short workaround now. Can ops apply tenant smoothing?

ops-oncall: Applying tenant override now: ephemeral_grace=12s, tenant_smoothing=true for tenant=heliotech for 40 minutes. Monitoring concurrent_init and rate_limit errors.

Kofi (Platform): Also recommend a short-lived token-proxy sidecar pattern for high-parallel edge fleets: fetch once per pod and reuse token for worker forks. We'll add this to the onboarding playbook.

heliotech-eng: After override at 14:20 UTC, error rate dropped from ~28% -> ~3% for new starts. We're testing the sidecar and plan to deploy SDK patch.

Abe (SDK): Opening PR SDK-642: "go-sdk: init jitter + token cache + init-cb" and marking hotfix. Snippet to recommend in the meantime: ```go
// simple process cache
var cached Token
func GetToken(){
  if cached.Valid() { return cached.Value }
  t := FetchEphemeral()
  cached = Token{Value: t.Token, Expiry: time.Now().Add(45*time.Second)}
  return cached.Value
}
```

Nora (CSE): I'll coordinate a 20-min runbook with HelioTech to walk through the sidecar and patch. Also drafting an account health note for renewal team; will highlight the quick mitigation to reduce risk.

ops-oncall: Override removed at 15:00 UTC. Metrics look stable. No regressions seen.

Abe (SDK): 0.6.1 published at 14:45 UTC with the cache+jitter+breaker. Added README section for edge fleets and recommended defaults.

heliotech-eng: Confirmed stable after rolling to 0.6.1 + sidecar. Thanks for the quick response.

Nora (CSE): Marking account health as green, scheduling renewal touch next week. I'll attach playbook links and the SDK PR in the customer ticket. Closing thread unless any regressions pop up. :white_check_mark:
